description: This file defines pandas-on-Spark specific features for DataFrame and Series, including methods for attaching ID columns, batch transformations, and batch transformations for DataFrame and Series objects. It also includes test code for running doctests with SparkSession.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkFrameMethods
classes.description: Provides pandas-on-Spark specific methods for DataFrame, such as attaching ID columns and batch transformations.

classes.name: PandasOnSparkSeriesMethods
classes.description: Provides pandas-on-Spark specific methods for Series, including batch transformation.

methods.name: attach_id_column
methods.description: Attaches a column as an identifier of rows, supporting different ID generation strategies.

methods.name: apply_batch
methods.description: Applies a function to the DataFrame in batches, returning a new DataFrame.

methods.name: transform_batch
methods.description: Transforms data in batches with a function that takes pandas DataFrame and outputs pandas DataFrame.

methods.name: transform_batch
methods.description: Transforms data in batches with a function that takes pandas Series and outputs pandas Series.
